ruleDefinitions.name: DumpMinitool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of "DumpMinitool.exe" a tool that allows the dump of process memory via the use of the "MiniDumpWriteDump"

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\DumpMinitool\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\DumpMinitool\\\.x86\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\DumpMinitool\\\.arm64\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "DumpMinitool\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "DumpMinitool\.x86\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "DumpMinitool\.arm64\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Full.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ Mini.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ WithHeap.*")))
